answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at signed dental nurse registration with dental council attestation. It requires a registration the dental council granted after a qualification, so the comet of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the vault first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The shale is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
